propositions: Impact-present ticket close command scales O(unique_historical_candidates × tracker_size) due to per-candidate full tracker-root os.listdir calls in resolve_ticket_id's short-id and generic-prefix resolution branches.

Current implementation performs 82 tracker directory scans (1 index build + 80 per-candidate scans) for 80 distinct non-alias historical reference candidates, dominating the 25–62 minute end-to-end close latency observed in production telemetry.

Short-id-shaped tokens, ordinary subject prefixes, and deprecated four-digit fragments fall through the pre-existing alias index and trigger individual full-store directory listings instead of indexed lookup.

Fix introduces build_resolver_scan_index to perform a single tracker-root pass creating ResolverScanIndex with sorted directory names, enabling short-id and prefix candidates to resolve via bisect O(log store) instead of per-candidate os.listdir.
Repair reduces tracker scans from 82 to 1 for the 80-candidate case while preserving all reference forms, ambiguity semantics, descendant credit, and file-impact-vs-diff enforcement.
